args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

Based on the itinerary for June 10th - June 20th, 2024

**Essentials:**
  • Passport
  • Plane ticket
  • Travel insurance
  • Hotel reservation

**Clothing:**
  • 3-4 tops/shirts
  • 2-3 pairs shorts/pants
  • 1-2 swimsuits
  • 1 light jacket for evenings
  • Undergarments
  • Comfortable hiking shoes
  • Sandals
  • Dress for Pearl Harbor

**Beach/Outdoor:**
  • Sunscreen (high SPF)
  • Sunglasses
  • Beach towel
  • Snorkeling gear
  • Water shoes

**Hiking/Diamond Head:**
  • Hiking boots
  • Water bottle
  • First aid kit

**North Shore Road Trip:**
  • Comfortable driving shoes
  • Snacks
  • Camera

**Luau/Evening:**
  • Dressy outfit
  • Light jacket
  • Camera

**Hotel/Relaxation:**
  • Swimwear
  • Comfortable robe

**Miscellaneous:**
  • Power adapter
  • Portable charger
  • Travel adapter
  • Reusable bag

**Documents:**
  • Driver's license
  • Health insurance card

**Notes:**
  • Check weather forecast before trip
  • Pack light for evenings
  • Bring reef-safe sunscreen
  • Consider packing a portable fan for hot days

**Created from vacation-plans.docx
